name: Azzas 2154 S.A.
summary: Azzas 2154 S.A. engages in the development and marketing of women's, men's and children's footwear, handbags, accessories, and clothing in Brazil and internationally. It offers its products through franchise stores, company-operated store, and web commerce channel under the Arezzo, Schutz, Anacapri, Alexandre Birman, Alme, Vans, Reserva, Reserva Mini, Reserva INK, Reserva Go, Oficina Reserva, Brizza, Troc, Baw, Carol Bassi, ZZMALL, Reversa, Simples Reserva, Paris Texas, Vicenza, Animale, Farm, Farm Global, Fabula, Foxton, Cris Barros, Off Premium, Maria Filo, NV, Hering and Dzarm brands. The company was formerly known as Arezzo Indústria e Comércio S.A. and changed its name to Azzas 2154 S.A…
